725:t_003:12.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Silence, Earthling brat. We have mastered the universe's truth.」

725:t_003:14.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「We do not hesitate to join forces to defeat that enemy.」

725:t_003:15.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Then, Father... Could you cooperate with us as well?」

725:t_003:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「What we must do now is defeat the $$御使い$$s and stop the universe's great collapse, which is still continuing.」

725:t_003:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「To do that, we must first stop fighting each other and join hands.」

725:t_003:18.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! You are hopelessly foolish!」

725:t_003:19.en:
$$ズール$$
「We joined forces because we acknowledged each other's power.」

725:t_003:20.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「It is laughable for a species barely at the threshold of $$シンカ$$ to think itself our equal.」

725:t_003:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...So you are just like the $$御使い$$s.」

725:t_003:22.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What a joke! Is your truth of living together just a bunch of villains sticking together?!」

725:t_003:23.en:
$$タケル$$
(They really are alike... And the source of their power is...)

725:t_003:24.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「But you need not worry. We shall oversee all universes in place of the $$御使い$$s.」

725:t_003:25.en:
$$ズール$$
「We shall stop the universe's great collapse as well.」

725:t_003:26.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You who possess fragments of the $$太極$$. We shall use you as our fighting force.」

725:t_003:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've sure moved up in the world. The bosses of the evil gods are trying to recruit me.」

725:t_003:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then I'll answer on behalf of the $$リアクター$$s.」

725:t_003:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I refuse, no matter how much money you offer!」

725:t_003:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「You couldn't possibly reject them more firmly.」

725:t_003:31.en:
$$ズール$$
「Fools. You willingly abandon your chance to obtain eternity?」

725:t_003:32.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「They are merely humans, a foolish species incapable of fully attaining $$シンカ$$.」

725:t_003:33.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Father... You... have no right to live in this universe...」

725:t_003:34.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「What did you say, $$グーラ$$?」

725:t_003:35.en:
$$刹那$$
「What this universe needs is a heart that accepts others and walks beside them!」

725:t_003:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「We don't need rulers like you or the $$御使い$$s!」

725:t_003:37.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I once said you were gods, albeit evil ones. Allow me to correct that now.」

725:t_003:38.en:
$$シモン$$
「Calling bastards like you gods is giving you way too much credit!」

725:t_003:41.en:
$$ズール$$
「Do not think gaining a little power will allow you to defeat us.」

725:t_003:42.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「We shall show you how this universe has strengthened our dark power as well!」

725:t_003:43.en:
$$タケル$$
「We have nothing more to say! We'll settle this here, you rulers of darkness!」

725:t_003:44.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you all right with this, $$グーラ$$?」

725:t_003:45.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Yes...! I... We must fight that enormous evil in order to live!」

725:t_003:46.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's do this! We'll defeat you and advance to $$エス・テラン$$!」

725:t_003:47.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Then I shall show you the power of a god!」

725:t_003:48.en:
$$ズール$$
「And you can regret your own powerlessness in the darkness!」

725:t_003:49.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Those without power die! You shall learn firsthand the natural order of the universe, which transcends even its truth!」

725:t_004:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You have some ability after all.」

725:t_004:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「I would expect no less of those who once defeated us and have now taken a step toward $$シンカ$$.」

725:t_004:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Knowing that, why are you so confident?!」

725:t_004:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Do you wish to know, $$ゼウス$$?」

725:t_004:4.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Our reason is that they have not entirely escaped being human.」

725:t_004:5.en:
$$ズール$$
「The darkness deep within them will devour them...!」

725:t_004:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「Now... Fall into the world of darkness!」

725:t_006:1.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「As a god, you would not understand.」

725:t_006:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Humans are weak creatures... Regret for the past and anxiety over the future constantly swirl in their hearts.」

725:t_006:3.en:
$$ズール$$
「Sometimes those feelings even seek to erase their own existence.」

725:t_006:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Oh, but it is! Humans constantly harbor the force that seeks to vanish within their hearts!」

725:t_006:6.en:
$$ズール$$
「Even as they generate the power of life, they remain captives of the force that seeks to vanish... the power of darkness! That is humanity!」

725:t_006:7.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Such creatures cannot possibly survive in this universe!」

725:t_006:8.en:
$n
「I've been listening to you spout whatever bullshit you please...!」

725:t_006:10.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Why are you not swallowed by your own despair?!」

725:t_006:11.en:
$n
「Bastards like you have used those attacks on me plenty of times...! I'm not going to keep taking it forever!」

725:t_006:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「Humans may indeed harbor darkness in their hearts, as you say...」

725:t_006:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「I lost my brother, and I live with that sorrow and regret...! But they give me strength!」

725:t_006:15.en:
$n
「The despair and anxiety in our hearts are also part of what makes us who we are!」

725:t_006:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll go on living, bearing both light and darkness!」

725:t_007:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That was close. That unwanted interference almost crushed me under my regrets.」

725:t_007:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll keep living, no matter how much regret and anxiety we feel!」

725:t_007:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Denying the past is pointless. We can no longer change it.」

725:t_007:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's why we live to make the future better!」

725:t_007:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$タケル$$! Your words woke me up!」

725:t_007:5.en:
$$葵$$
「$$マーグ$$'s presence gives $$タケル$$ strength.」

725:t_007:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「We'll follow your lead! We'll overcome the darkness inside us, instead of denying it!」

725:t_007:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「In your case, you merely repaid what you owed us.」

725:t_007:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, you only overcame hope and despair because we helped you!」

725:t_007:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Give it a rest, $n! Bragging about your achievements makes you less of a man!」

725:t_007:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But I am grateful to you, $n.」

725:t_007:14.en:
$$シン$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ sure goes easy on $n.」

kept_omissions: 725:t_003:23: Takeru's private thought begins to identify the gods' power source and stops before giving the answer; the darkness reveal follows in the scene.
725:t_004:6: Hibiki's truncated 'Wha' is the source's shocked exclamation at Xul's threat.
725:t_005:0: Takeru starts 'This is' and stops at the onset of the mental attack; no identification is supplied.
725:t_006:13: Xul calls Takeru 'Mars' in surprise that he has resisted the darkness; the source is a name-only shout.
725:t_007:7: Hibiki's 'What about me' is the deliberate elliptical request for acknowledgment after everyone thanks Takeru; Sousuke answers in 725:t_007:8.
725:t_007:10: Hibiki agrees with Alto but trails off after 'but'; Rand cuts off the attempt at claiming credit in 725:t_007:11.
725:t_007:13: Hibiki addresses Miss Suzune after she thanks him; the source supplies only the address.
